title: When you are tired of waiting
issueStatement: You are obeying only while outcomes feel fast, visible, or emotionally rewarding.
centralInsight: Patience in Gurbani is not limp delay. It is what settles into the body after mercy, saint company, and remembrance cool the inner rush.
practicalReflection: Impatience says, 'If this mattered, it would already be changing.' Gurbani asks instead whether the mind has become more teachable while it waits.
actionPrompt: Stay with one faithful practice for seven days without using your mood as the measure of its worth.

source.shortMeaning: Mercy and saint company cool the body into patience and composure.
source.lifeApplication: Do not imagine patience is always self-generated.

excerpts.explanation: The shabad ties patience to receiving help, not heroic isolation.

source.shortMeaning: Forgiveness, reverence, and fearlessness are part of the same spiritual musculature.
source.lifeApplication: Patience grows where retaliation and panic begin to loosen.

excerpts.explanation: Patience is stronger when bitterness has been reduced.

source.shortMeaning: Contentment and inner conquest matter more than outer performance.
source.lifeApplication: A patient life is often an interior victory before it looks like an exterior one.

excerpts.explanation: Guru links patience with the deeper work of mastering the inner field.
